tagline: King取景器相机，1960 年发布
description: King于1960年推出的取景器相机。配备Steinheil Munchen Cassar 45mm f/2.8。快门速度1/30-1/500th + B。感光度10-400。1m-Infinity。

specs.闪光灯: PC socket on the front, 1/30th sync in flash mode
specs.英文简介: The Regula Olympia Auto-Set was a 35mm viewfinder camera made at Bad Liebenzell in the Black Forest by King KG in the early 1960s as a part of their Regula brand.
